itemdesc-formaldehydeportion: A pungent preserving fluid. Seal food in a barrel with it to embalm the food forever. Not for drinking.
itemdesc-curingsalt: A dry mix of salt and lime. Pack food in a barrel with it to mummify the food forever.
desc-norot: Will never rot. Made for decoration: it goes on shelves, in display cases and on the ground (shift + right-click).
desc-toxic: <font color="#ff7a6b">Toxic! Eating it makes you sick, and worse the more you eat.</font>
toxicity-mild: The {0} tastes foul. Your stomach churns.
toxicity-queasy: You force down the {0}... and immediately throw it back up.
toxicity-retching: Your body violently rejects the {0}. You retch until your stomach is empty.
toxicity-poisoned: The preserving chemicals in the {0} burn through you. You feel poisoned.
toxicity-severe: Your vision swims and your limbs grow heavy. The {0} was a terrible mistake.
toxicity-lethal: You have eaten far too much preserved food. Your body is shutting down.
help-preserve: Preserve the food in your hand straight away (method: wax, resin, formaldehyde or saltcure)
help-unpreserve: Make the preserved food in your hand normal again
help-toxicity: Show how poisoned you (or another player) are from eating preserved food
help-info: Show how many foods the mod found and what it patched
handbook-guide-text:
Any food, vanilla or modded, can be preserved as permanent decoration. Preserved food keeps its exact look, never rots, and can go on shelves and in display cases.

Wax dipping: put the food and a piece of beeswax in the crafting grid.

Resin lacquer: put the food and a piece of resin in the crafting grid.

Formaldehyde soak: in a barrel, mix 5 litres of alcohol with 1 powdered borax to make formaldehyde solution. Then seal food in a barrel with the solution. By default it takes 0.25 litres per food item and 2 days.

Salt and lime cure: craft salt and lime into curing salt. Seal food in a barrel with the curing salt. By default it takes 1 curing salt per food item and 5 days.

Displaying it: preserved food goes on shelves and in display cases, and on the ground with shift + right-click, even food that normally can't. In creative mode, every food is ready-made in the Embalmed Eats tabs, one per method.

Do not eat it. The first bite makes you vomit. Keep eating preserved food and it turns into poisoning, nausea and sluggishness, and finally a lethal dose. The effect wears off with time.

Preserved food can't be cooked, ground or used in recipes.
handbook-formaldehyde-text: Put any food in a barrel together with formaldehyde solution and seal it. When it opens, the food is embalmed: it never rots, but it is poisonous to eat.
handbook-curingsalt-text: Put any food in a barrel together with curing salt and seal it. When it opens, the food is mummified: it never rots, but it is poisonous to eat.
